# ISO C17 Systems Programming Hub: CHIP-8 Emulator

> [!NOTE] Topic Overview
> A hands-on systems curriculum grounded in building, hardening, and optimizing the CHIP-8 Emulator in C17. Master binary I/O, bitwise opcode decoding, CPU execution cycles, memory invariants, SDL2 streaming, and modern CMake tooling.

## 🧭 Compass
- [🎯 Mission & Goals](../mission/): Master C17 systems programming by completing and polishing `chip-8-emu`.
- [📖 Canonical Glossary](../glossary/): Memory, UB, and compiler semantics definitions.
- [📚 Trusted Sources & Communities](../resources/): ISO standards, textbooks, and systems forums.
- [📝 Teacher Scratchpad](../notes/): CHIP-8 codebase audit and pedagogical roadmap.

---

## 🗺️ Curriculum Track

### Phase 1: Toolchain & Safe Binary I/O
- [x] [Lesson 0001: ISO C17 Standards, Compiler Diagnostics & CMake with SDL2](../lessons/0001-c17-standards-and-modern-toolchain/)
- [ ] [Lesson 0002: Safe Binary File I/O & ROM Loading into Memory at 0x200](../lessons/0002-binary-file-io-and-rom-loading/)

### Phase 2: CPU Architecture & Opcode Decoding
- [ ] Lesson 0003: 16-Bit Big-Endian Opcode Fetching & Bitwise Masking
- [ ] Lesson 0004: Instruction Execution: Function Pointer Jump Tables vs Switches
- [ ] Lesson 0005: Call Stack, Program Counter (PC) & Subroutine Invariants

### Phase 3: Hardware Peripherals & Optimization
- [ ] Lesson 0006: Graphics Engine: DXYN Sprite XOR Rendering & SDL Texture Streaming
- [ ] Lesson 0007: 60Hz Timers, Audio Synthesis & CPU Cycle Regulation
- [ ] Lesson 0008: Hex Keypad Input & FX0A Blocking Keypress Handling

### Phase 4: Production Hardening & Tooling
- [ ] Lesson 0009: ASan / UBSan Audit, Memory Invariants & Eliminating UB
- [ ] Lesson 0010: Building an Interactive Disassembler & ROM Step Debugger
